Frequently Asked Questions
What types of jobs does Zapply list?

We list entry-level, new grad, and internship roles across tech, marketing, design, finance, and more. Our listings include positions at FAANG companies, Fortune 500s, and fast-growing startups.

How often are new jobs added?

Our job board is updated daily with fresh listings. We pull roles from verified sources and remove outdated or ghost postings to make sure every listing you see is real and active.

Can I filter jobs by location or remote work?

Yes. You can filter by company, location, experience level, category, and whether the role is remote. You can also search by keyword to find specific roles or companies.

Do I need to create an account to browse jobs?

No — you can browse and search all job listings without an account. You only need to sign up if you want to use the Zapply autofill extension to apply faster.

How does the Zapply autofill extension work?

Install the free Chrome extension, add your resume and profile details once, then click the Zapply icon on any job application page. It autofills the entire form in seconds — including custom questions and dropdown menus.

Is Zapply free to use?

Yes, Zapply is completely free for job seekers. Browsing jobs, using the autofill extension, and joining our community all cost nothing.

Does Zapply support H-1B visa sponsorship filtering?

Yes. You can filter job listings to show only roles from companies that offer H-1B visa sponsorship, making it easier to find opportunities if you need work authorization support.

What makes Zapply different from other job boards?

Zapply combines a curated job board with a one-click autofill extension. Instead of manually filling out the same information on every application, you apply in seconds. Plus, our community of students and new grads provides support and advice throughout your job search.
